meta.name: Parineeta
meta.description: A chance meeting at a train station after years apart reignites old emotions between Lalita and Shekhar, sparking a tumultuous journey of love, jealousy, and complex bonds. Based on the timeless novel by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, Parineeta, streaming from 15 August, only on hoichoi.

videos.title: Yaadein
videos.overview: After four long years, Shekhar and Lalita cross paths at Monghyr station, reigniting feelings of envy, agony, and desire.
